properties.description: A sequence of 20 animation frames (164–240, every 4th frame) depicting a neon/fiber-optic style glowing tree on a dark background. The tree transitions from a full, structured tree shape with twisted trunk and expansive luminous canopy (blue, cyan, purple hues) in early frames, to a more dynamic, flowing, wispy form with an undulating S-curve trunk and dispersed particle-like canopy in later frames. The animation conveys organic growth, transformation, and dissolution of the tree structure. Watermark 'Veo' visible in bottom-right corner, indicating AI-generated video content.
properties.visual_style: Dark background, neon bioluminescent / fiber-optic aesthetic, blue-cyan-purple color palette
